evidence.title: We’re All Going to the World’s Fair is an intimate coming-of-age horror film

summary: The new movie “We’re All Going to the World’s Fair” blends horror with a personal coming‑of‑age story, following a teenage protagonist navigating identity and digital spaces. Critics note its intimate tone and unsettling atmosphere set it apart in the genre.
title: ‘We’re All Going to the World’s Fair’ Debuts as Intimate Coming‑of‑Age Horror Film
